bullets: The outcome range is 15.3 points wide at one sigma — p10 -2.1 to p90 +41.9 for San José State, so a projection of +20.9 still produces results a long way either side of it.
It is early enough that both ratings still lean on preseason belief — it widens the outcome range by about 4%.
